## Flash Magnus

Flash Magnus is the golden-amber pegasus legionnaire whom Rainbow Dash admires as a legendary hero. A member of the **Pillars of Old Equestria**, he represents **bravery**; he is **not Flash Sentry** or a disguise of another pony.

**Recognize him:** Dark-red mane and tail, turquoise eyes, Roman-style silver armor with a red-plumed helmet and scarf, and a fireproof shield. The [G4 character color guide](https://mlpvector.club/cg/pony/v/335-Flash-Magnus) records his design.

**Name and history:** *Flash Magnus* is his established name in licensed G4 media, appearing in IDW's *Legends of Magic* #4 (July 2017), before his animated debut in *Campfire Tales*. In the comics, he also risks his Royal Legion career to save griffons from a storm ([issue publication and synopsis](https://www.mycomicshop.com/search?TID=42382505)). Rockhoof's mistaken names “Hay Garrick,” “Mare E. Allen,” and “Whinny West” in issue #9 are DC *Flash* jokes, not separate identities ([comic allusions reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_allusions/Comics)); issue #11 mistakenly calls him “Flash Sentry” ([character and comic reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Flash_Magnus)). Comic stories are licensed G4 depictions, not automatically scenes from the television continuity.

**Speaking and appearances:** He **speaks**, voiced in English by **Giles Panton** ([episode cast](https://watch.plex.tv/en-GB/show/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic/season/8/episode/21)). In the show he appears in *Campfire Tales*, both parts of *Shadow Play*, *A Rockhoof and a Hard Place*, the ninth-season finale, and brief later images/cameos; after returning from limbo he becomes a Canterlot Royal Guard drill sergeant.

## Important moments

- **Volunteers to save captured comrades** — *Campfire Tales* (S7E16): He draws dragons away with his fireproof shield, allowing the Royal Legion to rescue its soldiers and trap the pursuers in lightning clouds. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uetL2pPwlUI) (scene timestamp unavailable).
- **Returns from a millennium in limbo** — *Shadow Play – Part 1* (S7E25): The recovered Pillars' artifacts bring him and his comrades home, but inadvertently release the Pony of Shadows too. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p1YsnZD-6X0) (scene timestamp unavailable).
- **Fights beside his new allies** — *Shadow Play – Part 2* (S7E26): He trusts Rainbow Dash and the others and helps the Pillars free Stygian from the Pony of Shadows. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U01UcYIdjU8) (scene timestamp unavailable).
- **Finds a place in modern Equestria** — *A Rockhoof and a Hard Place* (S8E21): As Celestia's new guard drill sergeant, he proudly welcomes old friend Rockhoof, whose own adjustment has been harder. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_MvbR4OxxlY) (scene timestamp unavailable).
